manifest.name: rank_countries_by_value
manifest.description: Ranks records by numeric value descending with rank, share of largest, largest, smallest and largest/smallest ratio.
manifest.notes: No network used. Input records have keys country, country_name, indicator, value, year. Records with value None are skipped; non-numeric strings raise ValueError. Ratio is None if smallest value is 0.

files.test_impl.py:
import pytest
from impl import run

EX = {'records': [{'country': 'IND', 'country_name': 'India', 'value': 1463865525, 'year': '2025'}, {'country': 'CHN', 'country_name': 'China', 'value': 1406585000, 'year': '2025'}, {'country': 'USA', 'country_name': 'United States', 'value': 341784857, 'year': '2025'}, {'country': 'IDN', 'country_name': 'Indonesia', 'value': 285721236, 'year': '2025'}]}

def test_example():
    out = run(EX)
    assert [r['country'] for r in out['ranking']] == ['IND', 'CHN', 'USA', 'IDN']
    assert out['ranking'][0]['rank'] == 1
    assert out['ranking'][0]['share_of_largest'] == 1.0
    assert out['largest']['country'] == 'IND'
    assert out['smallest']['country'] == 'IDN'
    assert out['ratio'] == pytest.approx(1463865525 / 285721236)

def test_unsorted_and_none():
    out = run({'records': [{'country': 'A', 'value': 1}, {'country': 'B', 'value': None}, {'country': 'C', 'value': 4}]})
    assert [r['country'] for r in out['ranking']] == ['C', 'A']
    assert out['ratio'] == 4
    assert out['ranking'][1]['share_of_largest'] == 0.25

def test_bad_input():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'records': []})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'records': ['x']})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'records': [{'value': 'abc'}]})
